# Retry round H1 on GPUs 4-5: one dtype per FSDP unit by casting everything to bf16, for policies
# whose code feeds bf16 tensors into their layers (fp32 weights fail there).
g05-fsdp2|g05-1|4,5|2|--parallelism.dp_shard=2 @AUTOWRAP|export FSDP_CAST_DTYPE=bfloat16
cover-wallx-fsdp2|cover-wallx|4,5|2|--parallelism.dp_shard=2 @AUTOWRAP|export FSDP_CAST_DTYPE=bfloat16
cover-fineart-fsdp2|cover-fineart3c|4,5|2|--parallelism.dp_shard=2 @AUTOWRAP --accelerator.fsdp.wrap_modules='["SiglipEncoderLayer"]'|export FSDP_CAST_DTYPE=bfloat16
